scientific.integrity: The closest primary X-ray source was materially inspected in full and searched for the exact object name. Exact-object, X-ray/illumination alias, Gauss-image, and broader-symmetry searches were performed. The proof is analytic for every n>=3; the bundled finite sweep is only a regression check.
limitations: The theorem is restricted to the uniform metric realization of convex antiprisms.
No claim is made for arbitrary nonuniform antiprisms or for ordinary illumination number.
The n=3 triangular-antiprism case is the already known regular octahedron component; the accepted claim is the complete all-n family theorem.
Unindexed older illumination literature remains a residual historical-overlap risk.

title: Every uniform antiprism has X-ray number three
